observations: Photo 0: a single light-colored wooden pallet, clean and apparently new, standing alone on a concrete floor.
Photo 1: a similar light-colored wooden pallet, close-up, also looking new and dry, same setting/watermark 'DANTILA RESOURCES'.
Photo 2: a different scene - a stack of several dark, weathered, worn wooden pallets outdoors, showing nail heads, splits and discoloration consistent with age/use.
No scale, certificate, or weighing device is visible in any photo.
No quantity is confirmed - unclear if the sale is for one pallet or a batch/stack as shown in photo 2.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows worn, dark, weathered pallets stacked outdoors, inconsistent with the 'clean, dry, sorted' description seen in photos 0-1.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, weighbridge ticket, or certificate is shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Mismatch between the clean new pallets shown in photos 0-1 and the worn/aged pallets in photo 2 - buyer may receive the worse stock.
risks.proof: A single photo or video showing the actual pallets to be delivered, with a shot including today's date/newspaper for freshness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the worn/aged condition seen in photo 2, not the clean condition in photos 0-1

risks.risk: Quantity sold is unclear - could be a single pallet or a bulk stack as implied by photo 2.
risks.proof: Seller confirms unit count and photographs the full lot together with a size reference.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single wooden pallet, the smallest plausible unit

risks.risk: No way to confirm wood type, dimensions, or load rating, which affect industrial resale value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of pallet markings/stamps (IPPC/heat-treatment stamp) and a tape-measure shot of dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded wooden pallet with no certification

risks.risk: 500kg weight claim cannot be tied to the actual item photographed.
risks.proof: A photo of the pallet(s) on a scale with the weight display visible.
risks.if_unproven: weight claim disregarded for pricing; priced by visual size/condition only

proof_requests: Photo of the actual pallet(s) to be sold alongside a scale or weighbridge ticket showing the weight.
Clear photo of all four sides including any IPPC/heat-treatment stamp for identification.
Confirmation of exact quantity being sold (single unit vs the stack seen in photo 2).
A fresh photo with date reference to confirm which condition (new vs worn) is what's being offered.
response.reason: The item is a wooden pallet (by type), but all supplied comparables are plastic pallets from a different material category and price band, so there is no valid wood-pallet comparable to anchor even a worst-case price.
